t: Anyone else tried Concord blades? | Badger & Blade
s: April 26, 2010 - I recently tried a Concord razor blade I bought from idiodic on eBay. The blades are described as "Platinum Chromium-Ceramic Tungsten-Polymer Coated Edge Super Stainless" and are made in Turkey. I'm currently using one in a 1937 Sheraton, and it's quite nice - not Feather sharp, but reasonably sharp, smooth and forgiving.
